system.description:
You no longer need to catch a subject's eye. The briefest brush of skin is enough to open their mind to your will.

Instead of making eye contact, make skin-to-skin contact with the subject (a Physical Challenge may be necessary). You may then use Dominate freely (retest Intimidation). The touch need not be maintained while you give the instruction, but you may issue only one command per contact; to Dominate the subject again, you must touch them again.
